nri_watch.headline: The World Cup in Your Backyard
nri_watch.description: For the first time, the biggest sporting event on Earth is being held across the US, Canada, and Mexico. NRIs can attend matches live in 16 cities — from MetLife Stadium in New Jersey to SoFi Stadium in LA.
